answer: This synthetic run passed 17 checks; that proves fixture coverage, not general correctness. Code enforces readiness, schemas, exact anchors, glossary, sensitivity, sign-off and spec-token checks; it groups conflict candidates. Models classify, flag garbles, extract, verify, recognise contradictions, synthesise, render and draft creative. Failed extraction/synthesis/render gates allow one repair, then stop. Humans record resolutions and signoff in brief.json; brief_review.html displays them, toggles languages and copies questions, but does not save decisions or sign. Checks cannot establish semantic support, natural Greek, complete questions or appropriate spec rows; creative errors remain review work. Creative stays shadow-only. Before week 1, the operator must rerun usage/time measurements under Sonnet extraction plus verifier; management/operator must validate subscription capacity and terms.
